metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover around Depok lower in 2019 than in 1990?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 5 TM for 1990 and Landsat 8 OLI for 2019 (both surface-reflectance collections). –Location: Depok, West Java (~6.4° S, 106.82° E). –Date: Whole calendar year (Jan–Dec) to guarantee enough scenes; build a single annual NDVI composite (median) to suppress clouds. 2. Masking: Apply the collections’ existing QA pixel-quality bands (cfmask for LT05, pixel_qa for LC08) to remove cloud/cloud-shadow and water. 3. Logic: Compute mean NDVI inside a 5-km buffer around Depok for each year. –If either collection is empty ⇒ C1. –If after masking no valid pixels remain ⇒ C2. –If computed NDVI is None/NaN ⇒ C3. –Else compare: if 2019 NDVI < 1990 NDVI ⇒ A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') depok = ee.Geometry.Point(106.82, -6.4).buffer(5000) def ndvi_composite(year, collection, band_red, band_nir, qa_band, cloud_bits): col = (collection.filterBounds(depok) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))) size = col.size().getInfo() if size == 0: return None masked = col.map(lambda img: (ee.Image(img) .updateMask(img.select(qa_band).bitwiseAnd(cloud_bits).eq(0)) .normalizedDifference([band_nir, band_red]) .updateMask(lambda ndvi: ndvi.gte(-1).And(ndvi.lte(1))))) comp = masked.median() count = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=depok, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('nd').getInfo() if count == 0: return None mean = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=depok, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('nd').getInfo() return mean ndvi90 = ndvi_composite(1990, ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C01/T1_SR'), 'B3', 'B4', 'pixel_qa', 68) # cloud+shadow+water if ndvi90 is None: print("C1") ndvi19 = ndvi_composite(2019, ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_SR'), 'B4', 'B5', 'pixel_qa', 272) # cloud+shadow+water if ndvi19 is None: print("C1") print(f"1990 NDVI: {ndvi90:.3f}, 2019 NDVI: {ndvi19:.3f}") if ndvi19 < ndvi90: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

depok = ee.Geometry.Point(106.82, -6.4).buffer(5000)

def ndvi_composite(year, collection, band_red, band_nir, qa_band, cloud_bits):
    col = (collection.filterBounds(depok)
                     .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')))
    size = col.size().getInfo()
    if size == 0:
        return None
    masked = col.map(lambda img: (ee.Image(img)
        .updateMask(img.select(qa_band).bitwiseAnd(cloud_bits).eq(0))
        .normalizedDifference([band_nir, band_red])
        .updateMask(lambda ndvi: ndvi.gte(-1).And(ndvi.lte(1)))))
    comp = masked.median()
    count = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=depok, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('nd').getInfo()
    if count == 0:
        return None
    mean = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=depok, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('nd').getInfo()
    return mean

ndvi90 = ndvi_composite(1990,
    ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C01/T1_SR'), 'B3', 'B4', 'pixel_qa', 68)  # cloud+shadow+water
if ndvi90 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

ndvi19 = ndvi_composite(2019,
    ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_SR'), 'B4', 'B5', 'pixel_qa', 272)  # cloud+shadow+water
if ndvi19 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

print(f"1990 NDVI: {ndvi90:.3f}, 2019 NDVI: {ndvi19:.3f}")
if ndvi19 < ndvi90:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
